name: Phoenix X
description:
Phoenix X is a beachfront condo located on the eastern edge of Orange Beach at the Alabama–Florida border, offering a rare combination of quiet shoreline and immediate access to Perdido Key attractions. Positioned along a peaceful stretch of sugar-white sand, Phoenix X provides easy access to both Orange Beach and nearby Florida destinations.
